provenance.numeric_grader: cfb_numeric_shadow_forward.py / frozen first-pregame numerical opportunity forecast
provenance.source_id_matching: date+game_id+player+market; player_id reconciled to first-seen ledger and strictly before kickoff

numerical.description: Do not average errors across yards and TD counts: different units. Use numerical_by_market.

limitations: Live thresholds are model-defined (69.5 rush yards, 1.5 passing TDs, 0.5 anytime TD), NOT verified market lines; do not claim sportsbook profit or executable wagers.
The 31 rushing-yard numerical values are expected conditional means from a frozen research model, not model medians or exact stat point forecasts certified for betting.
Game not final, unresolved games and players absent from recorded final stats are ungraded, NOT automatic zeroes or losses.
Correlated selections from the same game/player are not independent wagers; sample sizes are provisional.
The day cohort includes only games graded by the source report as of its timestamp; recalculate after all games finalize.
Do not promote or retune from already observed outcomes; this is an observational forensic audit.
